title: S14 scope and evidence rights
text: Close Regression Harness, review production evidence and defend one bounded claim. P02 remains optional and P04 separate.

title: Identity and release preflight
text: Record exact package, actual runtime, reviewed root and unresolved gates. No publication follows from this screen.

title: Readiness is an argument
text: Name the claim, owner, witness, falsifier and unknown. One green witness is not a release certificate.

title: Regression boundaries
text: Separate unit, integration and HTTP contracts. Use the cheapest sufficient boundary and observable behaviour.

title: Created is not persisted
text: A successful create response must be followed by a read that observes the saved state.

title: Mutation sensitivity
text: Kill wrong-status, missing-persistence, leaked-internal-error and shared-state with named assertions.

title: Repeat and clean
text: Run twice, attribute each failure and finish with zero active servers and zero active runs.

title: Production Evidence Review
text: Each row records claim, source, pass/fail/unknown, owner, next action and limit.

title: Install, audit, build and runtime differ
text: A locked install, dependency audit, build artefact and runtime health trace are separate witnesses.

title: Logs, config, HTTP and deployment
text: Redaction, secrets, safe errors, headers, TLS and proxy evidence have different owners and boundaries.

title: Demonstration evidence
text: Show one bounded behaviour, point to one witness and state exactly what it cannot prove.

title: Sampled individual defence
text: Answer one evidence question. The defence samples understanding; it does not replace the rubric.

title: Critique one sanitised claim
text: Preserve the relevant exchange, verify independently and allow UNKNOWN.

title: AI-use record and freeze decision
text: Record accepted and rejected AI-assisted changes, unresolved owners and whether the evidence pack may be frozen.

title: Do not manufacture completeness
text: Missing runtime, deployment or platform evidence remains UNKNOWN and blocks the corresponding claim only.

title: Evidence draft and STOP
text: Save one reviewed-PDF draft, list outstanding work and stop. No upload, release or final tag.
